operation_universe.definition: One row per stable, user-intentful Business management outcome family exposed by a declared route/service, plus every registered Ari tool and accepted open-work overlay. Polymorphic tools remain one operation family with variants; buttons and internal helpers are not separate operations.
operation_universe.external_overlay: GitHub issues #1736, #1743, #1753, #1796, #2000 at the audit timestamp
exclusions: buyer or anonymous web checkout/public-page operations
admin-only operations except read-only canonical-command evidence
authentication/session plumbing and provider callback routes
passive rendering, navigation-only taps, local form fields, and internal helpers without a distinct persisted/read outcome
future or closed issue ideas with no current Business source or accepted open-work owner

status_definitions.verified: Mapped tool plus distinct implementor and independent tester guards, exact-revision deployed runtime evidence, and production observation on every required surface.
status_definitions.registered_unverified: A real registered tool with source or regression evidence but insufficient exact-revision runtime proof.
status_definitions.broken: A mapped tool with a proven contract or runtime defect and an owning issue/evidence.
status_definitions.guided_handoff: No false completion claim; Ari directs the user to a concrete existing route or native/hosted flow.
status_definitions.unsupported: The Business operation exists but has no mapped Ari tool or accepted handoff.
status_definitions.in_flight: An open owning issue exists; registration elsewhere does not satisfy the operation.
